subject: Arithmetic expressions
notes: Citation re-validated INDEPENDENTLY: `--check 8.8.1.2 "the order of execution of consecutive operations of the same hierarchical level is from left to right"` => OK §8.8.1.2 3). || UPHELD, with my own evidence rather than the adjudicator's. Derived first: every level left-folds, exponentiation included — the standard states no right-associativity exception for `**`, so `2 ** 3 ** 2` = (2**3)**2 = 64, not 512. READ: `ExpressionBinder.BindChain` is `foreach (var child in StatementBinder.Children(node)) { if (child is AddOpContext or MulOpContext) op = child.GetText()[0]; else { var x = BindExprCore(child, context); acc = acc is null ? x : new BoundBinary(acc, op, x); } }` — a strict left fold serving BOTH AdditiveExpressionContext and MultiplicativeExpressionContext; and `ExpressionBinder.BindPower` is `acc = BindExprCore(bases[0], context); for (int i = 1; i < bases.Length; i++) acc = new BoundPower(acc, BindExprCore(bases[i], context));` — the same left fold for rank 2. I ALSO CHECKED THE CHILD ENUMERATOR the adjudicator took on trust: `StatementBinder.Children` is `for (int i = 0; i < node.ChildCount; i++) yield return node.GetChild(i);` — plain index order, no filtering, so no operand can be skipped and no pair re-ordered. `CompileTimeExpressionEvaluator.EvalArith`, the only other walker of this tree, left-folds identically over `node.ChildCount`. || TEST EVIDENCE VERIFIED BY READING BOTH GOLDENS AND THEIR .out FILES, not by trusting the citation: (a) tests/conformance/2014/func_expr_arg.cob header says verbatim '** folds LEFT per 8.8.1.2 r3', its body has `COMPUTE R = FUNCTION MAX(2 ** 3 ** 2, 1)` and func_expr_arg.out asserts `POW=00064` — right-folding gives 512, so it discriminates rank 2 and cites this exact rule; (b) tests/conformance/2002/arith_standard.cob has `COMPUTE W1 = 2 / 7 * 7` into PIC 9V9(5) with hand-derived §8.8.1.5 arithmetic in the header, and arith_standard.out asserts `W1=200000` — `2/(7*7)` = 0.0408 would print 004081, so rank 3 left-to-right is pinned, in the SDIDI lane. Both are spec-derived (hand-derived expectations, ISO citations in the headers), neither is a differential, neither is nist:/characterization:/MatchesLegacy. Rank 4 (`A - B - C`) has no golden, but it is the SAME `BindChain` loop already discriminated at rank 3 by (b) — associativity is decided once, in the binder, and no renderer re-associates (I verified `CombineCore` emits self-parenthesized forms only). Rank 1 is prefix-unary, where 'left to right' has no content. || I ALSO CHECKED THE SUBSCRIPT FAST PATH, a second evaluator the adjudicator did not consider: `ReferenceResolver.RenderSegment` splices `+ - * / ( )` into C# text, and C# gives those operators the same precedence and the same left associativity as COBOL, and `**` has no case arm so it routes to the D18 materializer — so rule 3's ORDER holds there too. (That path's VALUE defect — C# integer division — is recorded against GR-8.8.1.2-1; it is not an ordering defect.) The `_outermost` leak recorded against GR-8.8.1.2-1 likewise does not touch associativity. Editions: no Annex E change item for §8.8.1.2 (scanned); batch default.
